pr.title: chore(code): stack helper consolidation
pr.body: Closes #165 - 🟣 ~~[fix(cli): handle stale lock from crash (#185)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/185)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(docs): fix some stale docs (#184)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/184)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(docs): better lock/hint grouping docs (#183)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/183)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(cli): more consistent availability of --dry-run/-n in commands (#182)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/182)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(code): standardize output around anstream over bare println (#180)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/180)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(tests): new behavioral test coverage for lock/merge/repair (#179)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/179)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(code): stack helper consolidation (#178)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/178)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[chore(code): provider detection de-duping (#176)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/176)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(merge): no more infinite hang (#175)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/175)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(providers): don't fail on transient errors (#174)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/174)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(stability): structured errors for merge issues (#173)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/173)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: current_stack_branches anchors on stack_root, which is the trunk for a trunk-anchored stack, so it returns every sibling stack off the trunk and PR descriptions list unrelated branches.
